title: 第七章 蜕变武道家第八章 麻雀说话了
content_zh:
...
一个多小时后，林夜站在魔都希尔顿大酒店高层观景房巨大的落地窗前，一边品味着今年刚刚采摘的雨后龙井，一边欣赏着华灯初上，沉溺在五颜六色海洋里的魔都，还有那条宛若巨龙一般的浦江。
“这特么才是生活啊！”
民间有句话，当你没钱的时候，魔都就只是一片钢筋水泥，而当你有钱的时候，魔都才是那个纸醉金迷的十里洋场！
活了二十多年，直至此刻，林夜才算是窥得一角。
叮咚~
门铃声响起，林夜放下茶杯，打开房门，两位抱着四个箱子的侍者面带微笑。
“您好，林先生，这是您要的高压锅。”
“谢谢，帮我放到房间里就好。”
“好的。”
两位侍者帮林夜将高压锅放到房间里，并贴心的拆除了箱子、泡沫、防尘袋...
“林先生，如果您还有什么需要的话，请随时联系我们。”
“知道了。”
“林先生再见。”
侍者躬身一礼，缓缓退去，房间再度恢复寂静。
林夜托着下巴看着四个高压锅。
“古有术士以鼎炼丹，今有我林夜高压锅炼药，古代力量与现代科技结合，歪瑞古德。”
他按照自己之前预定好的方案，将药材一一分别放入高压锅，开始进行蒸煮。
约莫一个小时之后，第一锅高压锅里的药液宣告熬煮成功。
林夜取出药液，冷却到适宜温度，仰头一口灌下。

剧烈刺激的味道让林夜的眉头紧皱，一种反胃感涌上心头，又被林夜强行压下。
伴随着药液入腹，一股热能从咽喉蔓延到腹中，灼热的好像在肚子里点燃了一个大火堆。
他取出早已经用酒精消毒好的银针，开始在身上扎针。
这个药方包含了百年人参、鹿茸、雪莲...等各种极具能量精华的药材，普通人根本无法承受，强行硬补不仅不能吸收，反而会导致能量过强以至于五脏六腑受损，乃至器官衰竭。
这也就是所谓的——是药三分毒。
并非是单纯的有毒的意思，而是针对人体未必能够承受的意思。
所以必须要配合银针，打通穴窍玄关，以此来吸收药力，达到无损强化肉身的目的。
林夜并未实际使用过银针刺穴，但有lv.2的脑力加持，这一切都不是问题，他的脑海中早已经自动形成身体对应的穴位图，就连自己的肉身都因为脑力强化，而更加灵敏、协调。
伴随着银针刺穴，林夜发现自己的鲜血流动速度加快，同时，体内那一股灼热能量也随着鲜血不断运行而扩散至奇经八脉，游走全身各处。
起初，是一种撕裂般的剧痛感。
这种感觉就像是小时候输液加快速度，手臂里的血管犹如被刀割剑剐一样。
但它的疼痛等级要更强数倍不止，好像要撕裂林夜的血管，甚至于撕裂林夜整个肉体！
等度过了最初的疼痛之后，接下来便是一种酥酥痒痒的感觉，好像伤口在长出全新的肉芽，缓慢愈合一样。
如此，约莫过了足足两个小时，林夜才算是吸收完第一碗药液的全部药力。
“呼~”
他吐出一口气息，这气息竟然透着微微的白雾。
“我的感官，好像变强了。”
强大的脑力能让他清晰感知到自身变化，他的眼睛原本有些近视，大概一百多度，此刻好像缓和了不少，他的嗅觉更加灵敏，他的听觉也要强出许多。
“这条路子，走对了。”
林夜嘴角扬起，再次开始喝药，修行...

这一次，他发现自己炼化的速度要比第一次快一些。
content_en:
...
More than an hour later, Lin Ye stood in front of the huge floor-to-ceiling window of the high-rise viewing room of the Hilton Hotel in the Magic City, savoring the Dragon Well that had just been harvested after the rain this year, while admiring the lanterns at the beginning of the night, the Magic City drowning in the colorful sea, and the Pujiang River that looked like a giant dragon.
"This is life!"
There is a saying among the people that when you have no money, the Magic City is just a piece of steel and concrete, but when you have money, the Magic City is just a ten-mile foreign business!
After living for more than twenty years, Lin Ye had only gotten a glimpse of it until now.
Ding dong~
The doorbell rang. Lin Ye put down his tea cup and opened the door. Two waiters holding four boxes were smiling.
"Hello, Mr. Lin, this is the pressure cooker you asked for."
"Thank you, just put it in the room for me."
"Okay."
The two waiters helped Lin Ye put the pressure cooker into the room, and carefully removed the box, foam, and dust bags...
"Mr. Lin, if you need anything else, please feel free to contact us."
"Got it."
"Goodbye Mr. Lin."
The waiter bowed and slowly withdrew, and the room became silent again.
Lin Ye held his chin and looked at the four pressure cookers.
"In ancient times, there were warlocks who used cauldrons to make elixirs. Today, I, Lin Ye, make elixirs in a pressure cooker. The combination of ancient power and modern technology is called Wari Good."
According to the plan he had planned before, he put the medicinal materials into the pressure cooker one by one and started cooking.
About an hour later, the liquid in the first pot of pressure cooker was declared to be cooked successfully.
Lin Ye took out the medicinal solution, cooled it to a suitable temperature, and drank it in one gulp.
The intensely stimulating smell made Lin Ye frown, and a nauseating feeling surged into his heart, which was forced down by Lin Ye.
As the medicine enters the abdomen, a heat spreads from the throat to the abdomen, and it is so hot that it seems to light a big fire in the abdomen.
He took out the silver needle that had been sterilized with alcohol and started pricking the body with needles.
This prescription contains century-old ginseng, velvet antlers, snow lotus, and other medicinal materials with extremely high energy essence. Ordinary people simply cannot bear it. Forcible supplementation will not only fail to absorb it, but will lead to excessive energy, damage to the internal organs, and even organ failure.
This is what is called - it is three parts of medicine and poison.
It does not mean simply poisonous, but it means that the human body may not be able to withstand it.
Therefore, it is necessary to cooperate with silver needles to open up the acupuncture points, so as to absorb the power of the medicine and achieve the purpose of strengthening the physical body without damage.
Lin Ye had never actually used silver needles to prick acupuncture points, but with the blessing of lv.2 brain power, this was no problem. His mind had already automatically formed a map of the corresponding acupuncture points in his body, and even his physical body was more sensitive and coordinated due to the enhanced brain power.
As the silver needle pricked the acupoints, Lin Ye found that his blood flowed faster. At the same time, the scorching energy in his body also spread to the eight extraordinary meridians as the blood continued to flow, and traveled throughout the body.
At first, it was a tearing pain.
This feeling is like when I was a child and my infusion was sped up, and the blood vessels in my arms felt like they were being cut with a knife.
But its pain level was several times stronger, as if it was going to tear Lin Ye's blood vessels, or even tear Lin Ye's entire body!
After the initial pain was over, there was a crisp and itchy feeling, as if the wound was growing new granulations and healing slowly.
In this way, it took about two full hours before Lin Ye had absorbed all the power of the first bowl of medicinal liquid.
"Huh~"
He exhaled a breath, which was actually filled with a slight white mist.
"My senses seem to have become stronger."
His powerful brain power allowed him to clearly perceive his own changes. His eyes were originally a little short-sighted, about a hundred degrees, but they seemed to have softened a lot now. His sense of smell was more sensitive, and his hearing was much stronger.
"This is the right path."
forestYe raised the corners of his mouth and started drinking medicine again, practicing...
This time, he found that his refining speed was faster than the first time.
